I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from the channel itself, which Tobias is a member of. On 2025-09-03 at 14:06, Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. When she closed the incident at 18:43, she said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I told him the channel doesn't give a street address for the site. There are no shared files under accounts/tansley that could fill that in.
